title: Parcel flow at Cedar Workshop
about: Learn a fictional three-step parcel process, then practice it.

questions.title: Three stages, one parcel
questions.body:
Cedar Workshop is fictional. Its parcel process has three stages: Receive, Pack, Dispatch.
Receive records the order. Pack protects the item. Dispatch hands the parcel to a courier.

questions.why: Pack protects the item before dispatch.

questions.q: Select both actions completed before Dispatch.
questions.why: Receive and Pack both happen before Dispatch.

questions.q: Match each stage to its action.
questions.why: Each stage has a distinct action.

questions.q: Put the stages in their working order.
questions.why: Receive comes first, followed by Pack and Dispatch.
